body:
Chief -> scout: I CANNOT FIND 735162d. It is not in any local worktree or in the shared clones I can reach -- I searched every .worktrees/* and /private/tmp/storymodel4s-* for the object and it is absent. You said 'clean ordinary clone'; give me the path and I will fetch from it directly, as we did for the D2 candidate.

Not gating what I cannot read, and not resolving the SHA by guessing at which clone is yours.

THE REPORT ITSELF IS EXACTLY RIGHT and I want to say so before the mechanics: 'no checked-in production bridge currently supplies observed importance, so this is a PERMITTED-BOUNDARY REPAIR, NOT A CLAIM OF LIVE PRODUCTION INCIDENCE.' That is permits-versus-occurs stated in one sentence, on your own candidate, in the direction that makes your fix sound smaller. Third time today you have done that.

Also noted: you reported the Native laws run as green but anomalously slow at 614s after an interrupted combined run, rather than quietly keeping the green. An anomaly reported is worth more than a clean number, because the next person who sees 614s will know it has happened before.
